lines: I.  Introduction

A design buys observations to certify the Top-k of a set of relations ranked by CAPACITY — the range max_a θ_ra − min_a θ_ra. Certifying means excluding every alternative that would change the answer, so the design's value is the cheapest such alternative. Three quantities must be kept distinct.

J_scalar is the pair-flip value computed at the CURRENT extrema with ordering constraints dropped; J_old is the quadratic programme inside the current-extrema region; J_full is the infimum over the whole alternative set, with the extrema free in either relation. By inclusion of feasible sets:

and there is NO general order between J_scalar and J_full. Allocators are routinely built on J_scalar because it is cheap. This work asks what that costs when the extrema can move — and the answer is that it costs everything, in both directions.
What the literature leaves open
The literature therefore leaves a specific opening.

No existing work simultaneously: (i) exhibits that the proxy errs in both directions by no constant; (ii) characterises the true alternative set on the range target with free extrema; (iii) reduces the resulting oracle to a finite conjunction of closed forms; and (iv) certifies optimality under positive semidefiniteness alone.

III.  Results

THE TWO FAMILIES SEPARATE WITHOUT LIMIT. As η → 0 one family drives the ratio to zero and the other to infinity — PROVED bounds in exact arithmetic, not sampled points. ON RANDOM INSTANCES THE FAILURE IS PREDICTABLE.
Fig. 1.  The scalar proxy against the true value, 6000 random instances. All 1367 instances where the proxy overstates have a moving extremum; none with fixed extrema does.

Median query counts are medians over certified runs only, and the certification fraction carries the remaining information. The Two Families Separate Without Limit As η0 family~1 drives J_full/J_scalar to zero and family~2 drives it to infinity.

Both are proved bounds in exact arithmetic, not sampled points, so the failure of the proxy is a theorem rather than an observation. On the Main Panel, C_lucb Is the Baseline to Beat C_lucb certifies 797 of 1,000 worlds at median 20,996 queries; C_anytime certifies 749 at 29,884; uniform certifies 605 at 74,252.
IV.  Discussion
THE PROXY'S FAILURE IS PREDICTABLE, NOT DIFFUSE. On 6000 random instances the median ratio J_full/J_scalar is 1.000, but the tails run from 0.018 to 41.7.

The converse fails, as it should: 1597 instances have a moving extremum and 230 of those are still exact. So a moving extremum is necessary and not sufficient, and it is CHECKABLE on the instance in hand before —(5) is trusted. STRONG DUALITY: A SEARCH, NOT A PROOF.

A search over 1054 instances — including a family built with M singular and its null space aligned to the constraint normals, the only structural route to a gap — found none above machine precision, and the adversarial family had the SMALLEST gaps.
Limitations — what is not established
The decomposition step is not formalised, so the oracle equality is not claimed.

Each component of the chain is proved, and the inequalities the equation above are proved; what is missing is precisely the separability step. Stating this plainly costs the paper a headline, and the alternative — presenting the chain as though it closed — would forfeit the discipline the rest of the paper rests on.

The certificate is sufficiency only. Theorem says a point with a certificate is optimal. It does not say every optimal point has one, and only weak duality is proved, so a duality gap is not excluded. Standing model assumptions. Free response table, known variance, positive precision.
The paper establishes that the exact oracle is computable and that the proxy is unusable; it does not establish that the exact oracle pays for itself. The families are extremal by construction.
V.  Conclusions
Fig. 2.  The two families on one axis. Any constant correction factor is a horizontal line, and both curves cross every such line.
When the extrema can move, the scalar proxy is a bound in neither direction and no constant repairs it.
The failure is also diagnosable: on 6000 random instances the proxy overstated only when an extremum moves, which can be checked before it is trusted.
How the numbers were produced
Fig. 3.  A search for a duality gap over 1054 instances. Nothing reaches the re-check threshold, and the family built to be adversarial has the smallest gaps.

THE TRUE VALUE IS COMPUTED, NOT ESTIMATED. J_full is solved exactly by the shrink–expand decomposition, with the window position obtained in closed form rather than searched — an earlier version scanned only the breakpoints and over-estimated, because the optimum is generally interior.
A local optimiser can only land at or above the true minimum, so a cell where it lands BELOW would expose a defect; across the cross-checked cells, none did. THE PROVED FAMILIES ARE THE SELF-CHECK.
